_note: Campaign A (Mesen2) and its follow-up A4: runtime-verified replacements for stale or hedged notes. Evidence: plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/A1..A4 (ROM O, SHA-1 38de0c84...). Apply BEFORE mesen2-A_names.json (the names spec renames the SetPlayerGameOverFlag block; this spec still uses the old file name). Every comment entry carries an 'expect' guard (the instruction on the tagged line). 'expectOld' is not used: the current extract:lt prints the {address} tag on commented lines too (gaia-core writer.ts, emitLineTracking), and merge refuses expectOld on a tagged line. The spec therefore needs the extract:lt tree (and one new comment, 245854, can only be placed there).
